label: def:categorical-reeb-derivation
title: Categorical Reeb derivation
html:
Let A be a Frobenius--Hopf substrate in a rigid monoidal category \mathbf{C}. The categorical Reeb derivation is the morphism \xi_q \colon A \to A uniquely determined by:

  1. Normalization: The derivation is compatible with the contact form \varTheta, satisfying \xi_q \circ \varTheta = \varTheta. The derivation \xi_q preserves the contact structure on the state bundle \mathcal{S}.
  2. Derivation property: The morphism \xi_q satisfies the Leibniz rule with respect to the multiplication \mu of A: \xi_q \circ \mu = \mu \circ (\xi_q \otimes \mathrm{id} + \mathrm{id} \otimes \xi_q).

The period of the Reeb derivation is the smallest positive integer \Omega_q such that the iterated composition satisfies \xi_q^{\Omega_q} = \mathrm{id}_A. The derivation \xi_q encodes the observer drift. The periodicity condition ensures that the Reeb flow closes, yielding a discrete spectrum of frequencies on A. Each eigenvalue of \xi_q corresponds to a fundamental mode of the substrate.
